name: Abū Jaʿfar Muḥammad ibn Saʿdān al-Ḍarīr
summary: Blind Kufan grammarian and one of the great Qurʾān readers, pupil of Abū Muʿāwiya al-Ḍarīr, author of a book on grammar and one on the readings.
bio: Ibn al-Anbārī calls Ibn Saʿdān one of the great Qurʾān readers, the author of a book on grammar and a book on the readings, a pupil of Abū Muʿāwiya al-Ḍarīr and the teacher of Ibn al-Marzubān, and trustworthy.
Al-Zubaydī counts him in the fourth generation of the grammarians of Kufa. He died in 231/846.

sources.title: Ibn al-Anbārī, Nuzhat al-alibbāʾ fī ṭabaqāt al-udabāʾ (Cairo 1294/1877), pp. 212–213
